entities.name: Vehicle
entities.description: An artifact type introduced in Kaladesh; objects that can temporarily become artifact creatures when crewed.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where the Vehicle artifact type was introduced; its Vehicles looked like futuristic cars and flying aircraft carriers.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A famous skyship, appearing as a Vehicle in Dominaria.

entities.name: Weatherlight Compleated
entities.description: The Weatherlight corrupted into a semi-biological cyborg, an uncrewable Vehicle.

entities.name: Lita, Mechanical Engineer
entities.description: A character whose card created the first Vehicle tokens, named Zeppelin.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where Vehicles were re-imagined as pirate ships.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane whose Neon Dynasty set introduced Mechs, giant machines controlled by people or kami.

events.summary: The Vehicle card type is first previewed on Ovalchase Dragster at PAX West 2016.
events.quote: The Vehicle card type was first previewed on the card Ovalchase Dragster at PAX West 2016 .

events.summary: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty introduces Mechs to the Multiverse as Vehicles.
events.quote: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty introduced the concept of Mechs into the Magic Multiverse

events.summary: Lita, Mechanical Engineer creates the first Vehicle tokens, named Zeppelin.
events.quote: created the first Vehicle tokens, which are distinctly named "Zeppelin".

relations.note: The type was introduced in Kaladesh.
relations.quote: Vehicle is an artifact type introduced in Kaladesh .

relations.note: The corrupted, semi-biological version of the Weatherlight.
relations.quote: the former Vehicle is corrupted into a semi-biological cyborg
